full-stack web application — React SPA + FastAPI backend (gallery of ten AI-pattern example apps)

existing_self_description.text: Built with Spec4 (BWS4) is a living showcase of common AI application patterns, presented as a collection of small, self-contained example apps behind a single landing page.

architecture.summary: Layered monorepo in which each example app is a vertical slice: a thin FastAPI router in api/, a slice package (service, schemas, validator, versioned markdown prompts), and shared framework services in services/. Long-running run endpoints stream over SSE. The newest slice, router/, composes the others: one typed classification call scores four routes and code dispatches to the winner.

test_coverage.coverage_summary: Backend tests in backend/tests/ have per-slice folders (collab, react, orchestrated, router, services, embeddings, chained_calls, single_call) with recorded fixtures and golden JSON; router tests cover classification, evaluator, presets, route descriptions, dispatch, history, rerun, routes and run. Live-provider tests (including router/test_router_live_smoke.py) are deselected unless run with `-m live`. Frontend has 40 Vitest and Testing Library files in frontend/tests/, including router and catalogue-consistency tests. Per-module coverage is not measured.

incomplete_or_dead_code: Pre-v5 code (backend/app/main.py and the pre-v6 routers, services and tests listed in tool.ruff.extend-exclude) is excluded from ruff; removing the exclusions would report 366 findings and reformat 57 files, so `uv run ruff check .` passes without covering the older example apps.
mypy is likewise scoped to newer code only; older example apps are not type-gated.
The backend/app/main.py lifespan docstring still cites Render's free-tier spin-down, which is stale since the VPS cutover retired Render.
CLAUDE.md lists GROQ_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY as required, but backend/app/core/config.py declares both optional, so the documented and enforced env contracts disagree.

backend/app/api/router.py is added to main.py but whether it and the router package sit inside or outside the ruff/mypy exclusion lists could not be verified from the truncated pyproject.toml; main.py itself stays excluded.

change_risks.risk: Streaming run endpoints (planning, orchestrated, collab, react, router) open their own session inside the generator because a Depends(get_db_session) session is bound to the request scope and the response outlives the handler.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Open async_session_factory inside the generator for any new streaming endpoint; do not use Depends(get_db_session).

change_risks.risk: Ordered fallback chains of free-tier model slugs in the shared registry rot as providers retire slugs; the known-bad sets in agent_runtime.py are probe-derived.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Refresh the per-capability chains periodically, re-probe before assuming a code fault, and keep the live smoke run (`-m live`) for deliberate verification.

change_risks.risk: New files inside an already-excluded package are silently ungated.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Place new code outside every extend-exclude path, as backend/app/react and backend/tests/react do.

change_risks.risk: A failed second call returns HTTP 200 with status 'critique_failed' so the first output survives; treating non-2xx as the only failure signal would break this.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Keep the 200 + status contract and handle the status field on the client.

change_risks.risk: Metered capabilities are capped per UTC hour and enforced before provider calls; new model calls that bypass the shared registry would bypass the allowance gate.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Route all new model calls through services/model_registry.py or services/agent_runtime.py.

change_risks.risk: The loaded embedding model, fitted PCA projection, in-process peer message bus and ReAct duplicate-guard cache are per-process state, so multiple workers would break them.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Keep uvicorn at --workers 1; never add Gunicorn with multiple workers.

change_risks.risk: VITE_SENTRY_DSN is read at build time and the systemd EnvironmentFile does not reach `npm run build`.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Supply VITE_* variables in the shell that runs the frontend build, not via the service env file.

change_risks.risk: Postgres is Neon-hosted and unchanged by the VPS migration; installing a local database would diverge from the documented design.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Keep DATABASE_URL pointing at Neon and run Alembic migrations as part of deploy.sh.

change_risks.risk: main.py lifespan awaits warm_route_descriptions() outside the try/except that makes the embeddings warm-up non-fatal, so a failure there would prevent the whole API from starting.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Wrap the call in the same best-effort handling, or confirm the function cannot raise, before extending startup work.

change_risks.risk: The four route ids and cost order are defined in backend/app/router/constants.py and mirrored by hand in frontend/src/api/router.ts; drift breaks decision rendering and agreement history.
change_risks.mitigation_hint: Change both files together and keep the catalogue-consistency and router frontend tests passing.

security_observations: Unauthenticated public demo; abuse is limited by per-UTC-hour usage caps enforced before provider calls, and the Caddyfile deliberately adds no edge access control.
CORS is restricted to a single configured origin rather than '*'.
Production secrets live in /etc/bws4/bws4.env (root-owned, mode 0600, outside the repo); the repo contains env var names only.
Moderation log stores a salted hash of the question, not the question text.
The Router's no-model evaluator is a hand-written parser that never executes model text, with expression length and nesting depth caps.
other_notes: Frontend commands: `cd frontend && npm run lint` (oxlint), `cd frontend && npm test` (vitest run), `cd frontend && npm run preview`; CONTRIBUTING.md documents the equivalent `npm run <script> --prefix frontend` form.
Backend dev server: `uv run uvicorn backend.app.main:app --reload --port 8000`; backend tests alternative: `uv run pytest backend/tests`.
Live smoke run: `uv run pytest -m live` (deselected by default; includes backend/tests/router/test_router_live_smoke.py).
Alembic config at `backend/alembic.ini`; migrations in `backend/app/db/migrations/versions/` (0001-0014; 0014_router_histories adds the Router agreement and latency tables).

Router comparison re-run is an additional POST endpoint called by `startRouterRerun` in frontend/src/api/router.ts; its exact path was not shown (handler lives in backend/app/api/router.py, logic in backend/app/router/rerun.py).

Router limits (5 runs per visit, 2 model-call units per run, decision margin) are code constants in backend/app/router/constants.py and frontend/src/apps/router/runAllowance.ts, not environment variables.

Deployment (no Docker or PaaS config): netcup VPS (Debian 13); Caddy 2 serves frontend/dist with SPA fallback and reverse-proxies /api/* to 127.0.0.1:8000 with flush_interval -1; systemd unit `bws4-api` (deploy/bws4-api.service); release via deploy/deploy.sh (pull, rebuild, migrate, restart, ~30-40 s warm-up interruption). Canonical origin https://bw.spec4.ai; Render retired at the Phase 6 cutover.
Quality gates (ruff, mypy, pytest, vitest) are developer-run before push; no CI exists in the tree.
Prompts are versioned markdown files (e.g. `*_v1.md`, `answer_v2.md`, router `route_v1.md`) loaded by per-slice prompt loaders and services/prompt_loader.py.
Embeddings projection is pre-warmed in the FastAPI lifespan (non-fatal on failure); router route descriptions are also warmed there.
Optional GA4 analytics and per-route SEO meta handled in frontend/src/seo/ and frontend/src/analytics.ts.
Every source file begins with a 'Built with Spec4 AI - https://spec4.ai' header comment; backend modules import as `backend.app.xxx`.
Tests never touch a real database; they use a fake-session pattern (backend/tests/conftest.py).
CLA.md, LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md (BDFL governance) and CLAUDE.md are present.
